主要内容: On February 21, 2017, Dr. Dale Ando and Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. entered into a separation agreement. Dr. Ando's last day of employment was February 3, 2017. Under the agreement, Dr. Ando will provide transition services to the company's Chief Medical Officer for six months. He will receive continued base salary payments for 26 weeks and a cash payment of approximately $120,000 less taxes. Additionally, Dr. Ando will release the company and its affiliates from any employment-related claims. The agreement will be filed as an exhibit to the company's Form 10-Q for the quarter ending March 31, 2017. The CFO, H. Ward Wolff, signed the report on February 24, 2017.
